title: Director, Commercial Analytics
description:
Location: Princeton, NJ; Hybrid

Overview:

 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the US Head of Commercial Operations to design, implement, and manage data analytics and performance reporting systems. Your main responsibility will be to provide actionable insights that support decision-making and drive improvements in commercial outcomes. As the Director of Commercial Operations & Analytics, you will serve as a key analytics partner for commercial leaders across sales, marketing, and market access in the US. You will offer valuable insights and recommendations to fuel growth, optimize field performance, and analyze market and patient trends. Additional key responsibilities include developing reporting processes and assisting with the coordination of Monthly Business Reviews, focusing on KPIs, forecasting variances, and updates to the Latest Estimate.

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Lead the development, maintenance, and continuous enhancement of forecasting models supporting Latest Estimate (LE), annual budget planning, and Long-Range Planning (LRP) processes. Conduct in-depth analysis of market trends and product performance to identify growth opportunities and risks.
  • Evaluate overall business performance, including volume, market share, new patient starts, and KPIs, comparing actuals against forecasts and targets.
  • Assess performance and activity trends at sub-national levels to uncover opportunities, inefficiencies, and areas for improvement within the sales force.
  • Prepare monthly business reviews, utilizing a combination of third-party market data (e.g., prescriber, chargebacks, 867, 852 data) and internal performance metrics to guide executive decision-making.
  • (consolidating this and first bullet point into a single bullet) Develop and maintain executive-level dashboards and performance reports by integrating internal KPIs and third-party datasets to monitor business performance, track progress against sales objectives, and support strategic decision-making.
  • Lead the commercial analytics and business performance management function, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives.
  • Establish data governance standards and reporting best practices to ensure the integrity and consistency of commercial data. Analyze market trends, physician and account-level data, and promotional effectiveness to support segmentation, targeting, and brand strategy.
  • Provide support to field teams (sales and key accounts) by addressing data and reporting requests and delivering actionable insights for daily execution.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop demand forecast models.
  • Conduct data analysis, reporting, and generate actionable insights to support commercial brand strategy and execution.

 

Qualification:

 

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, or a related discipline; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum 12 years of progressive experience in Commercial Operations, Sales Operations, Business Analytics, or commercial excellence within pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
  • Demonstrated experience leading, developing, and managing high-performing analytic teams.
  • Strong understanding of the pharmaceutical industry and familiarity with third-party data sources (e.g., Symphony Health, IQVIA, etc.).
  • Ability to translate complex data into actionable business strategies and recommendations.
  • Ability to present complex analyses and recommendations clearly and effectively to senior leadership.
  • Strong proficiency in Excel
  • Exceptional analytical capabilities, including the ability to manipulate large data sets and apply advanced analytical methodologies.
  • Experience with BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, Qlik etc.) preferred.

title: Psychiatric Account Manager
description:
Overview:

The Psychiatric Account Manager is responsible for building relationships with recognized experts, and prioritized stakeholders in the therapeutic area, Community Mental Health Clinics, hospital/institutional systems and integrated delivery networks (IDNs).



The successful Psychiatric Account Manager will:


  • Develop and drive the relationship with target institutions and community accounts, including establishing and maintaining positive relationships with key influencers and decision makers within the accounts.
  • Achieve success in a complex, matrixed selling environment in which the need for collaboration and cross-functional discipline is critical. Cross-functional partners may consist of Account Partners, Market Access, Medical, Marketing and Operations colleagues.
  • Develop a strong, collaborative partnership with field-based colleagues to ensure the appropriate level of cross-functional support for customers within a defined geography and for developing and executing pull-through strategies.
  • Identify key influencers and achieve designated customer interaction expectations with a focus on top target customers.
  • Use data tools and insights, and other informational sources to determine strategies and tactics for business decision-making.
  • Demonstrate account-based selling skills (including group presentations, etc.). Build relationships in institutions aligned with customer segmentation.
  • Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action.
  • Deliver clinical brand specific presentations of product(s) to physicians and other appropriate health care professionals.
  • Develop deep product and competitor knowledge and understanding of local and regional market trends.
  • Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities.
  • Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner.
  • Execute the company brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area.
  • Participation in training and development programs.
  • Maintain adherence and compliance with all corporate, industry policies and procedures.

Requirements


  • BA/BS degree required; Life Sciences preferred.
  • 5+ years of direct selling experience to healthcare professionals in the Pharmaceutical, Biotech or Healthcare industry experience required.
  • Psychiatric experience is required. A working knowledge of the Schizophrenia field is strongly preferred.
  • CMHC account management and/or Hospital/Institutional experience strongly preferred.
  • Established relationships in the geography is strongly preferred.
  • Knowledge of formulary approval process and driving formulary approvals is preferred.
  • Must live near to territory boundaries.
  • Proven track record of success in a high science competitive selling environment.
  • Ability to identify key decision makers, develop positive relationships and strong customer dedication.
  • Proven track record of success in exceeding results.
  • Self-starter, highly motivated to succeed.
  • Strong communication, business analytics and account management skills.
  • Ability to work independently or in a team environment.
  • Valid driver’s license and safe driving record.

title: Sr Analyst, Sales Operations
description:
Location: Princeton, NJ; Hybrid

The Opportunity:  

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the Senior Director of Sales Operations to support the sales team in their day-to-day operations. You will support the commercial infrastructure that enables field force effectiveness and drives operational excellence across sales operations functions.. This role assists in incentive compensation, field analytics and reporting, CRM operations, territory design, fleet, and sampling. The ideal candidate has experience supporting sales teams, strong analytical capabilities, and the ability to partner cross-functionally to maximize field performance and commercial impact. 

 
Key Responsibilities: 

  • Serve as the primary contact for the Luye sales force in support of all day-to-day sales operations. 
  • Ensure data quality and integrity from various vendors/sources. 
  • Support the ongoing weekly and monthly reporting for field sales and sales leadership. 
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance Power BI dashboards and reports to support field sales performance, business insights, and leadership decision making. Assess sales planning strategies to measure sales force effectiveness. 
  • Administer and support CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce/Veeva), including call planning, targeting, segmentation, user support, workflow enhancements, and reporting. Translate data analysis into actionable insights and recommendations. 
  • Identify trends and opportunities across current and future products. 
  • Support digital engagement programs and field-triggered digital content  
  • Support sampling & sample compliance programs for the field 
  • Support the field Fleet program  
  • Act as the primary point of contact for Sales Teams regarding ICP bonus payouts and commission inquiries. 
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing stakeholders to develop and design compensation strategies and plans. 
  • Target setting and achievement calculation. 
  • Tracking MBO and contest results. 
  • Analyzing quarterly payouts. 
  • Ensure compliance with legal, regulatory, and quality standards for all field operations activities  
  • Provide support to field teams by addressing data and reporting requests, resolving inquiries, and delivering actionable insights for daily execution. 

Your Skills & Experience:  

  • Bachelor's Degree in analytics or related field required 
  • 3+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Commercial Analytics, Business Analytics, or a related function within the biopharma, or healthcare industry preferred. 
  • Proficiency in data visualization tools, specifically Power BI is preferred 
  • Ability to present analytical data to groups of Leadership and employees as needed 
  • Strong analytical skills 
  • Strategic thinking with strong attention to detail.

title: Sr Analyst, Financial
description:
Location: Princeton, NJ; Hybrid

The Opportunity:  

In this role, the Senior Financial Analyst is responsible for supporting financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, management reporting, and commercial analytics while serving as the primary finance resource for Gross-to-Net revenue accounting and forecasting.
This role partners closely with Commercial, Market Access, Supply Chain, Accounting, and Executive Leadership to provide financial insights and ensure accurate revenue recognition and reserve calculations. The position plays a critical role in forecasting net product revenue, analyzing gross-to-net deductions, and driving financial performance across the organization.

 
Key Responsibilities: 

  • Analyze rebates, chargebacks, returns, admin fees and discounts
  • Support Medicaid, Medicare, 340B and commercial contracts; calculate reserves and support ASC 606
  • Maintain documentation, support audits, internal controls and process improvements.

Your Skills & Experience:  

  • Bachelor degree in Finance, Accounting or related field
  • 5+ pharmaceutical finance experience
  • Advanced Excel required
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Financial modeling expertise
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong business partnership mindset
  • Project management and process improvement orientation
